review_brief:
# Review summary

Both assigned unapproved-but-implemented bases were checked without changing their
production generators or canonical authority. I built complete native parametric
families for `d0a85a878975` and `3fb5ef8ad60e`, preserving each canonical program
byte-for-byte as the default setting.

## d0a85a878975

- Added `block_order = construction | reverse_construction`.
- The parameter acts only after the input-derived square-count layers are built.
- Added a thin native adapter, promotion contract, exact Racket variants,
  constructive sampler, semantic-rival audit, focused tests and documentation.
- Supports 2–6 demonstrations and 1–4 queries with matched inputs and a 30×30 case.
- Fresh evidence: 14 task tests; 160 bounded episodes / 1,040 pairs; 24 audit Racket
  evaluations; four qualification jobs / 32 qualification Racket evaluations;
  one protected causal replay; 16 public views, 24 privacy invariance checks and
  four positive controls.

## 3fb5ef8ad60e

- Added `divider_reference = block_midrange | frame_midpoint`.
- Both settings detect the same frame and colored blocks, then B consumes the
  selected input-derived divider to place colors in the 2×2 summary.
- Added a thin native adapter, promotion contract, exact Racket variants,
  constructive sampler, semantic-rival audit, focused tests and documentation.
- Supports 2–6 demonstrations and 1–4 queries with matched inputs and a 30×30 case.
- Fresh evidence: 7 task tests; 160 bounded episodes / 1,040 pairs; 24 audit Racket
  evaluations; four qualification jobs / 32 qualification Racket evaluations;
  one protected causal replay; 16 public views, 24 privacy invariance checks and
  four positive controls.

## Review limits

The retained qualifications are explicitly
`authoring_preflight_not_owner_qualification`. Both returns are source-bound and
reviewer-ready, but only owner integration followed by fresh native qualification,
causal replay and acceptance can satisfy the admission objective. No training
admission is claimed. Final code review was an author self-review because this
harness exposes no independent subagent reviewer.

previous_catalog_record.summary: Ignore non-square distractors, count monochrome solid-square components by side length, conditionally remove one excess smallest square as the size key, then emit count-layered top-left nested-square tally glyphs.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The ordered list of active-size glyph blocks derived from the adjusted square counts.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Detect solid monochrome square components, map each side length to its color, count the sizes, apply the canonical smallest-key decrement, and construct the active-size count layers.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use the episode-fixed block_order setting to sequence those derived blocks and render each nested corner glyph into the output canvas.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The number, widths, color nesting, and sequence of rendered glyphs are determined by the input-derived block list; reversing or replacing that list changes where colors appear and cannot be chosen before the square counts are known.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready construction/reverse-construction family with matched inputs, 2-demo identifiability, four queries, 30x30 coverage and protected causal evidence.

target_report.summary: Built a source-bound native block-order family preserving the exact canonical default; bounded audits, authoring preflight, causal replay and public projection checks pass.
